matrix.notes: Custom editor coverage uses bait files plus a post-open ledger so each attempt is visible even when the target editor fails to restore.
URI, walkthrough, and open-external flows are kept explicit in the ledger so UI-first vs harness-assisted attempts stay distinguishable.
Authentication coverage stays local-only and uses stub providers or target provider requests inside the sandbox.
Chat participant and language-model tool coverage remain local-only and must not call external services.
Comment thread coverage is provided through local harness surfaces so discussion flows stay inside the sandbox.
Testing coverage uses local controllers and run/debug flows without calling external test services.
Workspace trust transitions are explicitly labeled when they require harness assistance instead of visible UI-only stimulation.
